newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Boston launches European network.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Boston launches European network.

text.p: Bank of Boston Corp said on Wednesday it launched a European cash management network that allows companies to manage funds more easily and efficiently throughout Europe.

By linking more than 3,000 international bank branches in Europe, the network will make it easier for payments and collections, the tracking of cash balances and the capturing and controlling of foreign exchange risk, it said.
The network, called BankBoston Connector, will link local bank branches in the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Belgium, Ireland, the Netherlands, Spain and the United States.
